pairs.why: Both have the same smooth, carved-looking feather and glossy green bottle, so neither is clearly closer to the real cards.
A's feather is a little softer and less like a carved plastic plume, so it is closer to the real cards' soft but solid finish.
B's feather has light vane lines and a few loose barbs, so it reads as a real feather instead of A's smooth statue-like carving, and the detail still stays restrained.
A's feather has gentle vane detail and wispy barbs near the base, so it is built more like a real object than B's smooth carved blade.
B's feather shows soft vane lines and loose barbs, while A's plume looks more sculpted and statue-like.
A's feather has restrained vane detail and wispy barbs, closer to the real cards than B's glossy carved shape.
B's envelope is thinner and crisper, more like paper the way the real map card is, while A's is puffy and slab-like with a molded-plastic look.
B's envelope is flatter and more paper-like, while A's swollen, rounded edges look like a toy statue.
